title: E-Commerce Delivery & Customer Experience
description: Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard to analyze e-commerce revenue, orders, delivery performance, customer reviews, product categories and geographic trends.
highlights: Measured delivery time, late-delivery rate and customer satisfaction.
Identified top product categories and states by performance.
Built interactive KPIs, slicers and business-focused visualizations.

title: Manufacturing Downtime Analysis
description: Cleaned and transformed manufacturing data, built a relational data model and developed an interactive Power BI dashboard to analyze downtime causes, product performance and production efficiency.
highlights: Cleaned and transformed production and downtime data using Power Query.
Built relationships between productivity, downtime, product and factor tables.
Created DAX measures for downtime, production time and batch performance.
Identified machine issues as the source of 42.2% of total downtime.
Designed an interactive dashboard with KPIs, slicers and performance charts.

title: E-Commerce Sales & Customer Analysis
description: Analyzed more than 500,000 e-commerce transactions using Python and Pandas. Cleaned missing, duplicated, cancelled and invalid records; explored monthly revenue, product and country performance; and applied RFM analysis to identify valuable customer segments.
highlights: Cleaned and validated more than 500,000 transactional records.
Analyzed monthly revenue, order volume and average order value.
Identified the highest-performing products and countries.
Segmented 4,338 customers using recency, frequency and monetary value.
Built a four-chart Matplotlib dashboard to communicate key findings.

title: AI-Powered E-Commerce Analytics System
description: Developed an AI-powered dynamic pricing and recommendation system using Python, data analysis and machine learning, supported by dashboards tracking products, orders, subscriptions and customer behavior.
highlights: Analyzed product, pricing, stock, order, subscription and customer data.
Built regression models for dynamic pricing decisions.
Designed KPI dashboards for product and customer performance.
